# gst-review

Unreleased standalone Rust GST coding and BAS reconciliation review aids.
Repository: https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/gst-review

Commands: gst-review review-coding and gst-review reconcile-bas. Both take one
JSON object on stdin. Money is supplied as decimal strings and dates as canonical
YYYY-MM-DD. They contact no service, write no files and lodge nothing. See README.md
for required fields, defaults, validation, states, limitations and checks.

The former gstreview Python import package is removed from this checkout.
Aus Accounting MCP still pins the published gst-review 0.1.0. Native version 1.0.0
and its publisher are pending; there are no published native release assets yet.

The retained law source check is dated 2026-10-19. Port qualification verifies
implementation parity rather than current legal advice. Obtain human review.
Ryan Duguid is not a registered tax agent or BAS agent. Use fabricated data for
software support and never submit taxpayer information. See DISCLAIMER.md.
